items.title: Shenzhen to Zhuhai by Bike
items.content_html:
A friend rode to Zhuhai last year, and this year he started pestering me early on to hurry up and buy a bike. Fine — I bought a Merida Warrior, plus quick-dry clothing, gloves, bike lights… a whole pile of odds and ends. National Day arrived, a 7-day holiday… and then — I got stood up. Very annoying: one went home, the other was out making extra money. Forget it, I figured a trip to Zhuhai was still worth it. In the evening I got in touch with some group friends, but none of them had time, or rather most had already set off on the 1st. Then let’s go wild once — sometimes you just have to do things alone anyway. I checked the route Baidu Maps gave, and it looked like this: this route is wrong, why does it loop all the way over to Guangzhou? What I found online was to cross by the Humen ferry and go straight to Nansha District in Guangzhou. Following the map’s suggestion would mean a big pointless detour. I can’t plan the route that way, so I’ll ride it in stages first. Stage one, from Shenzhen to the Humen ferry. Stage two, from Guangzhou’s Nansha District to Zhongshan. Stage three, from Zhongshan to Zhuhai. So, let’s start with stage one.

This time it’s right — time to set off, a solo trip. Starting from Bantian bus stop, heading up along Jihua Road, then Gongye Road, and finally turning onto Bulong Road. This stretch is mostly still in Shenzhen, and I could basically still run into other cycling groups — quite a few heading to Guangzhou or Songshan Lake, after all there were showers these past few days.

Reached Guangming, what a long stretch of road. There are so many forks in the roads here, and I took a wrong turn, so I had to double back. About to enter Furong Dao — bye bye, Shenzhen!

Chang’an, here I come.

No traffic jam today, which is nice. Just follow the S358 highway straight on and you’re fine — don’t look at the map, the map’s route winds around and is a total trap. Get here

From here you can go straight up, or go left, either is fine, as long as you reach Lundu Road. Lundu Road is really long — when you get tired just push the bike and walk a bit, my butt doesn’t hurt anyway. It’s my legs that hurt, and I’m a bit tired. The Humen ferry is here

The ferry was free, just watch out for safety. Stage one done. Across the water is Nansha District. At first hearing it sounds like you’ve arrived at the Nansha Islands.

On the map, Nansha District doesn’t look big, so why does it take so long to ride through? The map says to go to Shunde and then to Zhongshan

I reached Tingjiao Bridge in Nansha District. In the opposite direction there’s Hengli Avenue, which the signs say goes to Zhuhai, and judging by the map it’s much shorter than going from Shunde to Zhuhai. The map is wrong — so I decisively took Hengli Avenue. The whole way was one bridge after another, dump trucks everywhere, the air was terrible — luckily I’d brought dust-protection gear. This slope is so high, absolutely exhausting; only up close did I realize it was a bridge.

Arrived in Zhongshan a bit after 18:00 in the evening. Not easy. Stage two done.

Found a Shaxian snack shop to eat at, then checked Baidu Maps for nearby hotels, found one with good reviews, and rested. On the 3rd I got up at 6:30 sharp, finished breakfast at exactly 7:00, and set off. Past the bridge is downtown Zhongshan


Through Zhongshan, onto the main road the map indicates, heading for Zhuhai. Right after leaving Zhongshan comes the Jinzishan Tunnel, then after another long stretch you reach Sanxiang. Housing prices around Zhongshan are so low — just over 3K per square meter. I can’t take it!

For the next stretch, the map’s route is all left turns and right turns, so I just found myself a road that was more or less straight and rode that. On the way, almost at Zhuhai, a few raindrops fell. Zhuhai, here I come.

Riding from Sanxiang to Zhuhai, it’s best to keep to the left — there’s a dedicated lane on the left. Passed by a village.

Follow the main road all the way down; turn right at the Zhuhai city government and you’re at the seafront, and the road that hugs the sea is Qinglv Road. Fisher Girl, here I come.

Alright, the ride is finally over. It’s already 12:30, and the weather report still says rain, so I’ll hang out for a while. Follow Qinglv Road to the very end and you reach the Gongbei Port (the one to Macau). I didn’t bring a travel permit, so I just looked. Across from Gongbei Port is the Gongbei bus station, so I found a restaurant to eat at. Both the ticket office and the waiting hall of Gongbei bus station are on the 2nd floor, so I decisively pushed the bike upstairs. I found a spot with no ticket window and locked the bike up, then queued to buy a ticket. The ticket is 100, and at the ticket gate you buy a checked-baggage ticket for 30. That’s where Zhuhai ends. The only regret is the rain — otherwise I would have stayed a few more days. Also, the bus only goes to Futian and Luohu, so you transfer to the metro yourself when you get there. This ride took only a day and a half in total; mostly when I got tired I pushed the bike for a while. There are quite a few slopes, and for the route I tried to look at the map and then find shorter roads myself — you can’t just follow the map entirely.

items.title: 深圳—珠海骑行
items.content_html:
朋友去年骑行去珠海，今年老早就嚷着告诉我赶快买车。好吧，买辆美利达勇士，速干衣、手套、车灯……乱七八糟的一大堆东西。 国庆来了，7天长假……结果—被放鸽子了。很生气，一个回家，一个在赚外快。算了，想想还是有必要去珠海一趟。完上联系去群友，都没时间去，或者说大部分1号已经出发了。那就疯狂一回吧，反正有些时候总要一个人去做些事情的。查查百度地图给的线路是这样的 这地图路线不对，怎么绕到广州去了，在网上找到的是从虎门渡轮过去，直接到广州南沙区的，按地图提示岂不是绕了一大圈子冤枉路。不能这样去查地图，那就先分阶段骑行。 第一阶段从深圳到虎门轮渡。 第二阶段从广州南沙区到中山。 第三阶段从中山到珠海。 那么，先从第一阶段开始吧。

这回对了，开始出发，一个人的旅行。 从坂田公交站出发，沿着吉华路一直往上走，接着是工业路，最后转到布龙路。 这段路是在深圳多一点，基本上还能碰到同样骑行的队伍，去广州的、松山湖的还挺多的，毕竟这几天有阵雨。

到光明了，好长的一段路。 这边的路好多岔口，还绕错了，只好折回来。 要进入芙蓉道了，深圳拜拜！

长安，我来了。

今天没堵车，挺好的，顺着s358公路一直往上走就对了，别看地图，地图号绕，特坑。 到这里

这边往上走，或者左走都行，只要能到轮渡路。 轮渡路好长，累了就推车走走吧，反正我屁股不疼。就是腿疼，累点。 虎门渡轮到了

没费渡轮，注意安全就行了。 第一阶段结束。 过了对面就是南沙区。咋一听跟到了南沙群岛似得。

地图上看南沙区不打，为毛骑车要好久。 地图提示要到顺德在到中山

我到南沙区的亭角大桥了，反方向有条横沥大道，提示是往珠海，从地图上看，比从顺德到珠海近了好多，这地图有误，果断从横沥大道走。 一路上是不断的过桥，到处都是渣土车，空气好差，幸好我带了防尘装备。 这坡好高，累死了，到近处才知道是桥。

晚上18:00多到中山了，不容易啊。 第二阶段结束。

找家沙县吃吃饭，然后百度地图附近，找到一家评价不错的酒店，休息。 3号一大早6:30起床，吃完早餐刚好7:00，出发。 过了大桥就是中山城区


穿过中山，到地图上指示的主干道，往珠海。 刚出中山就是金字山隧道，然后再过一段长长的路程就是三乡，中山这边房价好低3K多一平，伤不起啊！

接下来这段路地图上的是左拐右拐的，我就自己找条比较算直线的路骑。 路上快到珠海了，还来几点雨。 珠海，我来了。

三乡往珠海的骑行最好是走左边，左边有专门的通道。 偶过一个村。

沿着大路一直往下走，到珠海市政府往右拐就是海岸边，靠近海的就是情侣路。 渔女，我来了。

好了，总算骑行完毕，已是12:30，看看天气说还是有雨，那就玩一会。 顺着情侣路一直走到底是拱北口岸（去澳门的），我没带通行证，看看就是了。拱北口岸对面是拱北汽车站，找个饭店吃饭。 拱北汽车站售票和候车厅都在2楼，果断推车上去。找个没售票的地方把车锁上，排队买票。 车票100，去检票口买托运票30。珠海就结束啦。不过遗憾的是，有雨，要不然得多玩几天。 还有，汽车只到福田和罗湖，到地方自己转地铁。 这次骑行也就一天半时间，大多是累了推车走会，坡道比较多，线路尽量看地图然后自己再找找近距离的路线，不能完全看地图走。
